applies_to: final run only; initial run retained
reason: Initial repeat-level clearing of the shared citation cache made the first method returning a citation pay its re-resolution cost. Final comparison uses all 57 proofs primed during index build for every method equally.
validation: Every query still rebuilds/revalidates the live immutable tenant snapshot before and after ranking. Source/tenant/version changes fail closed. Index proof priming cost is reported separately as index_build_seconds.
benchmark_scheduling: Final benchmark is run after own unit/full-backend tests finish, without overlapping those suites.
interpretation: Small fixed in-memory synthetic corpus only; validation cost and ranking cost separate; not production latency guarantee.
